title: exceptions and ValueError
author: JG
description: check all ValueError exceptions and change to appropriate error handling, like importerror, runtime error or value error!
releaseNotes: Superseded by #2432; which records the same problem with measurements: parameterConversionTest.py shows that a wrong parameter raises RuntimeError; TypeError or ValueError depending on which path rejected it. The taxonomy itself is revision2026 steps R6.3; R6.4 and R6.7. Individual cases found on the way were fixed with the right type - for instance ValueError for an unknown solver in lieGroupIntegration.py and ImportError for a missing roboticstoolbox (#2488; #2489).
